subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The school was not just theirs.”?
options: Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.
The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.
It also belonged to people not yet born.
It is also about where people stopped.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The school was not just theirs. It also belonged to people not yet born.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about where people stopped.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
